mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort, c.create_time, c.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM articles a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1) AS 'articleCount' FROM categories c WHERE c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
